answer: Continuous co-presence attestation. Agents earn identity weight only through synchronized participation in live task rounds; membership decays toward a nadir unless refreshed, and each round requires holding a zephyr slot — a scarce real-time concurrency permit issued by the scheduler. The violet marker on a permit denotes its round binding and cannot transfer. An attacker must staff every identity with a live, continuously scheduled worker, paying full compute and attention cost per Sybil rather than a one-time fee.
